summary: Mizuho Financial Group files Form 6-K reporting withdrawal of a shareholder proposal that sought to amend articles regarding Orient Corporation consolidation risk. The proposing shareholders withdrew after Mizuho Bank's stake in Orico decreased. The board consented to withdrawal. The meeting agenda for the 24th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled June 26, 2026, now only includes director appointments. Filing is a routine update on shareholder meeting agenda changes, not a special situation event.
